description: Export the daily moderation statistics shown on the analytics page as UTF-8 CSV. Requires a service JWT obtained from the caller PDS (com.atproto.server.getServiceAuth) with aud set to the admin service DID and lxm set to the invoked method. Columns and definitions match the page; every export is audited and rate limited.

queueId.description: Restrict the statistics to one report queue.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The upstream service credential is not configured.

errors.name: UpstreamAuthFailed
errors.description: The upstream service rejected the administrator credential.

errors.name: UpstreamUnavailable
errors.description: The upstream service is unreachable or timed out; no file is generated.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: The export or the upstream service was rate limited.
